verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs Agents documents built-in agent analysis. Custom success-evaluation criteria assess conversation quality, goal achievement and customer satisfaction, alongside sentiment analysis, data extraction and conversation search, which covers the core of AI-reviewed scoring and resolution analysis. Real conversations where the agent underperformed can also be turned into test cases. missing for 10: explicit documentation that evaluation is LLM-driven and runs automatically on every call, explicit failure flagging or alerting, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI reviews my calls for me — scoring quality, flagging failures, and analyzing resolution automatically

citations.quote: Success evaluation: Define custom criteria to assess conversation quality, goal achievement, and customer satisfaction
Sentiment analysis: Understand user sentiment across completed conversations
Transform real conversations into test cases when you find an interaction where the agent underperformed.
